data.name: Status_Caption
data.value: A snapshot of your Claude and Codex backups across all configured folders.

data.name: Targets_Caption
data.value: Folders where AgentPortable writes backup ZIPs. Let OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, or your own sync client handle the upload.

data.name: Targets_SetActiveTooltip
data.value: Make the selected folder the backup destination for 'Backup now'.

data.name: Discovery_Caption
data.value: What AgentPortable found on this machine (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex CLI and the Codex app). Paths whose EXISTS column says No are skipped during backup; choose what to back up on the Status page. Cowork is not listed as its own row: session state lives under AppData\Roaming\Claude\local-agent-mode-sessions (already covered by the Claude Desktop AppData row), and the project folders you opened in Cowork are auto-discovered and backed up separately. Codex login tokens (auth.json) are never backed up.

data.name: Restore_Caption
data.value: Select a snapshot from a configured target or browse to any claude-backup_*.zip on disk (handy when you moved to another machine). AgentPortable moves the current Claude and Codex data aside to <folder>_backup_<timestamp> before restoring — nothing is deleted.

data.name: Restore_AdvancedCaption
data.value: Override where the restore writes files. Use this when the backup was taken under a different Windows user name (e.g. sascha on the workstation, sasch on the laptop). All sub-paths (AppData\Roaming, AppData\Local, .claude, .codex, .cowork) are derived from this root. Leave blank to use %USERPROFILE%.

data.name: Restore_IgnoreVersionMismatchHint
data.value: (skip the major-version block; chat-history schema may differ)

data.name: Logs_Caption
data.value: Most recent 500 lines from this session. Logs persist in memory only — restart clears them.

data.name: Schedule_Caption
data.value: Windows scheduled tasks visible from this machine. AgentPortable-managed entries are highlighted in green; foreign tasks that touch Claude, Cowork or Codex paths (like a hand-written backup PowerShell script) are highlighted in orange. Use Refresh after creating or removing a task elsewhere.

data.name: Schedule_AutoBackupCaption
